packageRules.description: trellis owns the action, image and toolchain pins of the projects it generates, so they move here, in template/, and reach projects through their trellis update.
The stable toolchain moves in this repository and in the template together, so `just pins` holds in one PR.
The lints' nightly moves with `clippy_utils` and the template's `lints_nightly`, through `cargo dylint upgrade` by hand.
clippy_utils is pinned to the lints' nightly, and dylint_linting and dylint_testing to the cargo-dylint the workflows install. They move together by hand; see CONTRIBUTING.md.
Crate updates other than major ones arrive as one PR.
